title: U.S. House, District 18
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 18th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Incumbent Scott Franklin (R) and NPA candidate Deva Simmons are on the Nov. 3 ballot per Ballotpedia. The Democratic nominee appears to be Curtis Gibson: an NBC News live-results snippet showed Gibson far ahead of Tiffanie Luong and BallotReady/Ballotpedia snippets list Gibson as the nominee, but no news article confirming the result was found, so treat the Democratic nominee as PROVISIONAL. Sources: https://ballotpedia.org/Florida's_18th_Congressional_District_election,_2026 ; https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-primary-elections/florida-us-house-district-18-results ; county makeup per WUSF map breakdown (district now centered on Polk with part of Osceola). Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Scott Franklin
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide F000472 per congress.gov district-map page)
candidates.background: Scott Franklin has represented the district since January 2021 (first elected in the old 15th, then the 18th after 2022 redistricting); he is a retired Navy aviator and former Lakeland city commissioner. He was the Republican candidate in the Aug. 18, 2026 primary; under the 2026 map the district is centered on Polk County with part of Osceola County.
candidates.primary_result: Republican nominee (Ballotpedia; primary details not found in snippets)
